title: The 10 Best Foods to Boost Nitric Oxide Levels Naturally for Better Performance
abstract:
### 7. Nuts and Seeds  
Nuts, especially walnuts and flaxseeds, contain arginine and alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), both of which support nitric oxide production and endothelial health.  
A [controlled trial by Xiao et al.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28457654/) (2018, *American Journal of Clinical Nutrition*) found that a nut-rich diet improved endothelial function and nitric oxide bioavailability in older adults.  
**Coach’s Tip:**
Add a handful of nuts to your daily diet — they provide healthy fats and a steady arginine supply for long-term cardiovascular support.
### 9. Salmon and Fatty Fish  
[Salmon](https://bodybuilding-wizard.com/salmon-for-bodybuilding-and-fitness/) doesn’t contain nitrates directly, but improves nitric oxide function through its omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and enhance endothelial responsiveness.  
[Research by Zehr et al.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5803420/) (2019, *Atherosclerosis*) demonstrated that EPA and DHA supplementation increased nitric oxide bioavailability and endothelial function in overweight adults.  
**Coach’s Tip:**
Include 2–3 servings of fatty fish per week. Omega-3s complement NO-boosting foods perfectly.
### 10. Whole Grains and Oats  
Whole grains are rich in polyphenols and magnesium, both of which support nitric oxide synthase function. [Oats](https://bodybuilding-wizard.com/unlocking-the-power-of-oats-and-oatmeal-muscle-building-for-vegans-and-vegetarians/), in particular, contain avenanthramides, antioxidants that protect nitric oxide from degradation.  
A [study by Huihu Xi et al.](https://www.jandonline.org/article/S2212-2672%2822%2901196-0/abstract) (2023, *Journal of the American College of Nutrition*) found that oat-based diets improved vascular health and endothelial NO activity in adults with mild hypertension.  
**Coach’s Tip:**
Swap refined carbs for oats or quinoa — the long-term benefits for blood flow and cardiovascular health are worth it.
